title: Backup and Restore Wizard
description: Comprehensive backup/restore wizard that handles Docker volumes, *Arr databases, Plex/Jellyfin metadata, and configuration files. Supports local, S3-compatible, and rclone destinations with scheduled backups.

phases.name: Backend Infrastructure
phases.description: Build the control-server API endpoints for backup operations

subtasks.title: Create backup types and schemas
subtasks.description: Define TypeScript interfaces for backup configs, destinations (local/S3/rclone), backup manifests, and progress tracking. Create Zod schemas for request validation.
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive TypeScript interfaces and Zod schemas for backup system including: destination types (local/S3/rclone), backup configs, manifests with checksums, progress tracking, restore configs, schedules, and history. All schemas include proper validation with size limits and type constraints.

subtasks.title: Implement backup service core
subtasks.description: Create BackupService class with methods to: discover backup targets (volumes, configs, databases), calculate backup size, create compressed archives (tar.gz), and generate backup manifests with checksums.
subtasks.notes:
Implemented comprehensive BackupService class with the following functionality:
- discoverBackupTargets(): Discovers configs, databases, metadata, and volumes from running containers
- calculateBackupSize(): Calculates total backup size with support for volumes and container paths
- createBackupArchive(): Creates compressed tar.gz archives with progress tracking
- generateManifest(): Generates backup manifests with SHA256 checksums
- validateBackup(): Validates backup integrity using checksums
- Helper functions: archiveVolume(), archiveContainerPath(), getDockerVolumes(), getRunningContainers(), etc.

Supports all major media stack services: *Arr apps (Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, etc.), media servers (Plex, Jellyfin), download clients (qBittorrent, Deluge, etc.), and request management (Overseerr, Jellyseerr).

subtasks.title: Implement encryption module
subtasks.description: Create encryption utilities using Node.js crypto for AES-256-GCM encryption of backup archives. Support password-based key derivation (PBKDF2).
subtasks.notes:
Implemented comprehensive encryption utilities module with AES-256-GCM encryption and PBKDF2 key derivation:

**Core Functions:**
- encryptFile(): Stream-based encryption for large backup archives
- decryptFile(): Stream-based decryption with authentication verification
- verifyPassword(): Quick password validation without full decryption
- getEncryptionInfo(): Returns encryption algorithm details

**Security Features:**
- AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption (256-bit keys)
- PBKDF2 key derivation (100,000 iterations, SHA256)
- Random salt (256-bit) and IV (128-bit) per file
- Authentication tag prevents tampering
- Custom file format with magic bytes (MSBKUP01) and version header

**Implementation Details:**
- Streaming encryption/decryption for memory efficiency
- Embedded metadata in file header (salt, IV, auth tag)
- Automatic cleanup of partial files on errors
- Detailed error handling with password verification
- Follows existing patterns: createLogger(), getErrorMessage(), async/await

The module provides production-ready encryption for backup archives with strong security guarantees.

subtasks.title: Implement storage destination adapters
subtasks.description: Create adapter pattern for backup destinations: LocalAdapter (filesystem), S3Adapter (AWS SDK), RcloneAdapter (shell wrapper). Each adapter handles upload, download, list, and delete operations.

subtasks.title: Create backup API routes
subtasks.description: Implement Fastify routes: POST /api/backup/create (start backup), GET /api/backup/status/:id (progress), GET /api/backup/list (list backups), POST /api/backup/validate (verify integrity), DELETE /api/backup/:id (remove backup).

subtasks.title: Create restore API routes
subtasks.description: Implement Fastify routes: POST /api/restore/preview (analyze backup contents), POST /api/restore/execute (perform restore with optional selective restore), GET /api/restore/status/:id (progress tracking).

subtasks.title: Implement backup scheduler
subtasks.description: Create scheduler using node-cron for automated backups. Support configurable intervals (daily/weekly/monthly), retention policies (keep N backups), and health check notifications.

subtasks.title: Register backup routes in app
subtasks.description: Update app.ts to register backup and restore routes. Add scheduler initialization to index.ts.

phases.name: Frontend Backup Store
phases.description: Create Zustand store and hooks for backup state management

subtasks.title: Create backup store
subtasks.description: Create Zustand store for backup wizard state: destination config, selected items, encryption settings, schedule config, backup history, and active backup/restore progress.

subtasks.title: Create backup API hooks
subtasks.description: Create React hooks for backup operations: useBackupCreate, useBackupProgress (polling), useBackupList, useRestoreExecute, useRestoreProgress. Handle loading, error, and success states.

phases.name: Backup Wizard UI
phases.description: Build the multi-step backup wizard interface

subtasks.title: Create BackupWizard main component
subtasks.description: Create main wizard component with step navigation, progress indicator, and step content rendering. Match existing SetupWizard patterns with GlassCard styling.

subtasks.title: Create DestinationStep component
subtasks.description: Step 1: Configure backup destination. Tabs for Local/S3/Rclone. Local: path input. S3: endpoint, bucket, access key, secret key. Rclone: remote name, path. Test connection button.

subtasks.title: Create SelectionStep component
subtasks.description: Step 2: Select what to backup. Checkboxes for: All configs, Individual service configs, Docker volumes, Databases (*Arr SQLite, etc.), Plex/Jellyfin metadata. Show estimated size for each.

subtasks.title: Create EncryptionStep component
subtasks.description: Step 3: Configure encryption. Toggle for encryption on/off. Password input with confirmation. Strength indicator. Warning about password recovery.

subtasks.title: Create ScheduleStep component
subtasks.description: Step 4: Configure backup schedule. Enable/disable scheduling. Frequency selector (daily/weekly/monthly). Time picker. Retention policy (keep N backups).

subtasks.title: Create ReviewStep component
subtasks.description: Step 5: Review and execute. Summary of all settings. Start backup button. Progress display with: current step, percentage, estimated time remaining, transfer speed.

subtasks.title: Create BackupProgress component
subtasks.description: Real-time backup progress display with animated progress bar, current operation label, file counts, size transferred, speed indicator, and ETA. Used in ReviewStep.

phases.name: Restore Wizard UI
phases.description: Build the restore wizard interface with validation

subtasks.title: Create RestoreWizard main component
subtasks.description: Create restore wizard with steps: Select backup, Validate integrity, Choose items, Confirm, Execute. Include pre-restore safety warnings.

subtasks.title: Create BackupSelector component
subtasks.description: Step 1: List available backups from destination. Show date, size, contents summary. Support filtering and sorting. Allow selecting backup to restore.

subtasks.title: Create ValidationStep component
subtasks.description: Step 2: Validate backup integrity. Check checksums, decrypt if encrypted (password prompt), show validation status for each component. Block proceeding if validation fails.

subtasks.title: Create RestoreSelectionStep component
subtasks.description: Step 3: Choose what to restore. Tree view of backup contents. Allow selective restore (e.g., only Sonarr config). Show current vs backup comparison where applicable.

subtasks.title: Create RestoreConfirmStep component
subtasks.description: Step 4: Confirm and execute. Warning about service interruption. Option to stop services before restore. Backup current state before restore option. Execute button with progress.

subtasks.title: Create RestoreProgress component
subtasks.description: Real-time restore progress similar to BackupProgress. Show stopping services, extracting files, applying configs, restarting services phases.

phases.name: Backup Management Dashboard
phases.description: Create backup history and management interface

subtasks.title: Create BackupDashboard component
subtasks.description: Main dashboard showing: last backup status, next scheduled backup, backup history list, storage usage, quick actions (backup now, restore, manage schedules).

subtasks.title: Create BackupHistoryList component
subtasks.description: Paginated list of past backups with: date, size, status, contents summary. Actions: restore, download, delete. Filter by date range.

subtasks.title: Create ScheduleManager component
subtasks.description: Manage backup schedules: view active schedules, edit schedule settings, enable/disable schedules, view schedule history.

phases.name: Integration and Navigation
phases.description: Integrate backup features into the main app

subtasks.title: Add backup routes to App.tsx
subtasks.description: Add React Router routes for /backup (dashboard), /backup/new (wizard), /backup/restore (restore wizard). Update navigation.

subtasks.title: Add backup to sidebar navigation
subtasks.description: Add Backup section to ModernSidebar with links to dashboard, create backup, and restore. Include status indicator for scheduled backups.

subtasks.title: Add backup widget to HealthDashboard
subtasks.description: Add backup status card to main health dashboard showing: last backup time, next scheduled, health status. Quick backup button.

subtasks.title: Add backend unit tests

subtasks.title: Add frontend smoke tests
subtasks.description: Create Playwright tests for backup wizard flow: destination setup, item selection, encryption config, schedule config, backup execution.

subtasks.title: Verify all acceptance criteria
subtasks.description: Manual testing to verify: one-click backup, compression, encryption, all destination types, integrity validation, scheduled backups, progress display with ETA.

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can backup all service configs and databases with one click
Backups are compressed and optionally encrypted
Support for local directory, S3, and rclone destinations
Restore wizard validates backup integrity before restoring
Scheduled automated backups with configurable retention
Backup progress shown with estimated time remaining
